claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve and a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee, totaling 540,750 ADA.
UTxO RPC is an open interface specification for standardizing interactions with UTxO-based blockchains using Protocol Buffers and SDKs in Rust, Go, Node.js, .NET, Haskell, and Python.
The document states that UTxO RPC has been adopted by Amaru, Dingo, and the Haskell Cardano node as a query interface.
The project maintains more than 10 repositories covering the core specification, language-specific SDKs, documentation, and provider integrations under the Apache 2.0 open-source license.
The funded work would maintain protobuf compatibility and documentation, official SDKs, community support, and AI-friendly integration resources.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested amount does not, at submission time, breach the 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.
TxPipe received Intersect 2025 open-source maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC, all stated to be delivered on schedule.

Intersect will administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multi-party authorization rules, external oversight entities, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for one year of UTxO RPC maintenance and enhancement by TxPipe, administered through Intersect's treasury smart-contract framework with stated oversight, NCL compliance, and Intersect budget-process support.
